# PATHWAY ANALYSES
```{r}

# create ranked gene vector from DEA result
make_ranked_genes <- function(dea_df) {
    dea_df %>%
        filter(!is.na(P.Value), !is.na(logFC), !is.na(Gene)) %>%
        mutate(stat = (logFC) * -log10(P.Value)) %>%
        arrange(desc(stat)) %>%
        distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
        dplyr::select(Gene, stat) %>%
        deframe()
}

# pull MSigDB pathway collection
get_msigdb_pathways <- function(category, subcategory) {
    msigdbr(
        species = "Homo sapiens",
        category = category,
        subcategory = subcategory) %>%
        group_by(gs_name) %>%
        summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_symbol)), .groups = "drop") %>%
        deframe()
}

# run fgsea after intersecting pathways with ranked RNA-seq universe
run_fgsea <- function(ranked_genes, pathways, rrs_group, interval,
                      min_size, max_size, seed = 819) {
    
    pathways_use <- pathways %>%
        map(intersect, names(ranked_genes)) %>%
        keep(~ length(.x) >= min_size & length(.x) <= max_size)
    
    set.seed(seed)
    
    fgseaMultilevel(
        pathways = pathways_use,
        stats = ranked_genes,
        minSize = min_size,
        maxSize = max_size,
        scoreType = "std") %>%
        mutate(
            RRS_Group = rrs_group,
            Interval = interval,
            n_pathway_genes = lengths(pathways_use[pathway]),
            leadingEdge = map_chr(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")) %>%
        arrange(padj)
}

ranked_genes_EDWK2 <- make_ranked_genes(high_RRS_ED2WK)
ranked_genes_ED6M  <- make_ranked_genes(high_RRS_ED6M)

GO_BP_pathways <- get_msigdb_pathways(category = "C5", subcategory = "GO:BP")

Reactome_pathways <- get_msigdb_pathways(
    category = "C2",
    subcategory = "CP:REACTOME"
)

fgsea_inputs <- tibble(
    result_name = c("EDWK2_fgsea_gobp","EDM6_fgsea_gobp", "EDWK2_fgsea_reactome", "EDM6_fgsea_reactome"),
    ranked_genes = list(ranked_genes_EDWK2, ranked_genes_ED6M, ranked_genes_EDWK2, ranked_genes_ED6M),
    pathways = list( GO_BP_pathways, GO_BP_pathways, Reactome_pathways, Reactome_pathways),
    RRS_Group = "High_RRS",
    Interval = c("ED-to-WK2", "ED-to-6M", "ED-to-WK2", "ED-to-6M"),
    Pathway_Database = c("GO:BP", "GO:BP", "Reactome", "Reactome"))

fgsea_results <- fgsea_inputs %>%
    mutate(
        fgsea = pmap(
            list(ranked_genes, pathways, RRS_Group, Interval),
            ~ run_fgsea(
                ranked_genes = ..1,
                pathways = ..2,
                rrs_group = ..3,
                interval = ..4,
                min_size = 50,
                max_size = 500)))


EDWK2_fgsea_gobp <- fgsea_results %>%
    filter(result_name == "EDWK2_fgsea_gobp") %>%
    pull(fgsea) %>%
    pluck(1) %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(Weighted_Score = -log10(padj) * abs(NES)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Weighted_Score))

EDM6_fgsea_gobp <- fgsea_results %>%
    filter(result_name == "EDM6_fgsea_gobp") %>%
    pull(fgsea) %>%
    pluck(1) %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(Weighted_Score = -log10(padj) * abs(NES)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Weighted_Score))

EDWK2_fgsea_reactome <- fgsea_results %>%
    filter(result_name == "EDWK2_fgsea_reactome") %>%
    pull(fgsea) %>%
    pluck(1) %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(Weighted_Score = -log10(padj) * abs(NES)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Weighted_Score))

EDM6_fgsea_reactome <- fgsea_results %>%
    filter(result_name == "EDM6_fgsea_reactome") %>%
    pull(fgsea) %>%
    pluck(1) %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(Weighted_Score = -log10(padj) * abs(NES)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Weighted_Score))

fgsea_combined <- fgsea_results %>%
  filter(result_name %in% c(
    "EDWK2_fgsea_gobp",
    "EDM6_fgsea_gobp",
    "EDWK2_fgsea_reactome",
    "EDM6_fgsea_reactome"
  )) %>%
  transmute(
    result_name,
    fgsea
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(fgsea) %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    Interval = case_when(
      str_detect(result_name, "^EDWK2") ~ "ED vs 2WK",
      str_detect(result_name, "^EDM6") ~ "ED vs 6M"
    ),
    Database = case_when(
      str_detect(result_name, "gobp$") ~ "GO-BP",
      str_detect(result_name, "reactome$") ~ "Reactome"
    ),
   `Weighted Score` = -log10(padj) * abs(NES), 
    `RRS Group` = "High RRS"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Interval, Database, everything(), -c(result_name, RRS_Group)) %>%
              
  arrange(Interval, Database,  `RRS Group`, pval, padj, log2err, ES, NES, `Weighted Score`, size, leadingEdge) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Pathway = pathway, 
                `P Value` = pval, 
                FDR = padj,
                Log2Err = log2err, 
                ES = ES, 
                NES = NES, 
                `Pathway Size` = size, 
                `Leading Edge Genes` = leadingEdge)

write.csv(fgsea_combined, "2WK Analyses/FGSEA/Combined FGSEA Analyses.csv")

```

## Export 
```{r}
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)

# Format fgsea results for export
format_fgsea_export <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Enrichment_Direction = dplyr::case_when(
        Interval == "ED-to-WK2" & NES > 0 ~ "Enriched at WK2",
        Interval == "ED-to-WK2" & NES < 0 ~ "Enriched at ED",
        Interval == "ED-to-6M"  & NES > 0 ~ "Enriched at 6M",
        Interval == "ED-to-6M"  & NES < 0 ~ "Enriched at ED",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
    dplyr::select(RRS_Group, Interval, Enrichment_Direction, pathway, pval, padj,
                  log2err, ES, NES, size, leadingEdge) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj, dplyr::desc(abs(NES)))
}

# Apply formatting
EDWK2_fgsea_gobp_export <- format_fgsea_export(EDWK2_fgsea_gobp)
EDM6_fgsea_gobp_export <- format_fgsea_export(EDM6_fgsea_gobp)

EDWK2_fgsea_reactome_export <- format_fgsea_export(EDWK2_fgsea_reactome)
EDM6_fgsea_reactome_export <- format_fgsea_export(EDM6_fgsea_reactome)

# Create workbook
wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()

openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "GOBP ED-WK2")
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "GOBP ED-6M")
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "REACTOME ED-WK2")
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "REACTOME ED-6M")

openxlsx::writeData(wb, "GOBP ED-WK2", EDWK2_fgsea_gobp_export)
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "GOBP ED-6M", EDM6_fgsea_gobp_export)
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "REACTOME ED-WK2", EDWK2_fgsea_reactome_export)
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "REACTOME ED-6M", EDM6_fgsea_reactome_export)

# Format sheets
for(sheet in names(wb)) {
  openxlsx::freezePane(wb, sheet = sheet, firstRow = TRUE)
  openxlsx::addFilter(wb, sheet = sheet, rows = 1,
                      cols = 1:ncol(openxlsx::readWorkbook(wb, sheet = sheet)))
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, sheet = sheet, widths = "auto", 
                         cols = 1:ncol(openxlsx::readWorkbook(wb, sheet = sheet)))
}

# Save workbook
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb,
  file = "2WK Analyses/FGSEA/High RRS FGSEA GOBP and REACTOME.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE)

```

## Figure 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

top10_gobp <- EDWK2_fgsea_gobp %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(desc(Weighted_Score)) %>%
 slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(
    pathway_clean = pathway %>%
      str_remove("^GOBP_") %>%
      str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
      str_to_sentence(),
    pathway_clean = fct_reorder(pathway_clean, NES),
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(padj)
  )

GOBP_figure6 <- ggplot(top10_gobp, aes(x = NES, y = pathway_clean, fill = neg_log10_padj)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    name = "-log10\n(FDR)",
    low = "#FBE7A1",
    high = "#E8C95A",
    na.value = "white",
    limits = c(1, 4.2),
    breaks = c(2, 3, 4),
    labels = c("3","3", "4")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1,2), labels = c("0", "1", "2")) +
  labs(title = "Enriched GO BPs\nED \u2192 2WK\n", x = "NES ED \u2192 2WK\n + NES = enrichment at 2WK", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"), 
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7), 

        legend.position = "right")
```
